notes.title: Hello, world! - Announcing Chipmatic
notes.content:
[h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3780950/Chipmatic/"][/dynamiclink]Get ready to mine, upgrade and automate in Chipmatic![/h3][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]I’m excited to finally reveal [b]Chipmatic[/b], a factory-building game where you control [i]Chip[/i], a mining robot on a mission to dig to the core of a ruined Earth. Gather resources, automate production, upgrade yourself, and uncover the secrets buried deep underground.[/p][p]If you enjoy:
✅ Satisfying automation
✅ Exploring the unknown
✅ Building the ultimate factory
✅ Upgrading your robot to absurd levels[/p][p]…you’ll want to keep an eye on this one![/p][p][/p][h3]📅 Release Date[/h3][p]I’ll be sharing more details about the release soon, but what I know for sure is that it'll be in [b]2026[/b]. In the meantime, you can [b]Wishlist Chipmatic[/b] to stay updated and get notified on release![/p][p]Thank you for the support! More updates coming very soon.[/p][p]- Molter[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3780950/Chipmatic/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
